framing_rules.golden_rule: Measure present-moment enjoyment only. Never reference future jobs, careers, salaries, or adult work roles.
framing_rules.required_framing: Ask whether the child is enjoying this activity right now.

present_moment_prompt.description: Short, child-friendly question about enjoying the activity NOW.
examples: Do you like fixing toy wheels right now?
Is building with blocks fun for you today?

response_modality.description: Filled by modality router — not by the LLM.

sample_generated_task.present_moment_prompt: Is snapping blocks together fun for you right now?

activity_scene.simple_picture_description: A plain side-view drawing of two hands stacking three blocks. No faces. Neutral colors.
activity_scene.optional_video_loop_description: A 3-second loop of blocks clicking together with no background music.
